# Instructions for accurately documenting structural defects in a bridge maintenance report

1. Start with the maintenance records.
2.
completion:
Mark each structural defect in the photos on a sheet of paper.
3. Write the description of the defect on it and stick it in the maintenance records.
4. Write down the time required to repair the defects on the opposite page. When you have finished with the structural defects, do the same for all the other defects.
5. Calculate the estimated cost of repairs if the complete documentation is available.

You should now have a detailed report of the problems and the time required to repair them.

# Introduction

The purpose of this instruction document is to enable the responsible inspector to produce a detailed account of a concrete bridge structure's condition. The account should be so detailed that the maintenance work can be planned in advance and that the required time to repair it can be estimated if the bridge gets damaged.
